description: This file defines the ITransactionManager interface and the AccessCounter struct for transaction management in Orleans. It includes method signatures for preparing, committing, and pinging transactions, as well as counting read/write accesses.
external_methods: Task<TransactionalStatus> PrepareAndCommit(Guid, AccessCounter, DateTime, List<ParticipantId>, int)

classes.name: AccessCounter
classes.description: A struct that counts read and write accesses on a transaction participant, with an operator to add counters.

methods.name: PrepareAndCommit
methods.description: Requests the transaction manager to prepare and commit a transaction, returning the transaction status.

methods.name: Prepared
methods.description: Notifies the transaction manager that a participant has prepared, with the outcome status.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a keep-alive or status check message to the transaction manager.

calls: Task<TransactionalStatus> PrepareAndCommit(Guid, AccessCounter, DateTime, List<ParticipantId>, int)
